description: Derives the esse contract through the OPEN Eleatic principle (every existent at w has causal power), the q.25 a.1 reading (whatever has active power is in act in some respect) and the q.4 a.1 ad 3 reading (act in some respect implies act of esse). A Platonist about causally inert abstracta rejects the Eleatic premise, not the derivation.
